name: Address Form
summary: Canonical Form profile that composes target-owned localized address fields, explicit submission, optional non-reset cancellation, and external mutation lifecycle.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Canonical native Form root carrying .form and .address-form plus a dual-named inline-size container; target owns action, method, authentication, and mutation handling.

anatomy.name: fields
anatomy.description: Canonical .form__section containing the complete target-owned composition of address Input and Select controls.

anatomy.name: row
anatomy.description: Optional canonical .form__row with the U7 compact responsive profile; it adds no semantic grouping or field API.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Optional canonical .form__actions row containing explicit submit and non-reset cancellation Button composition.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic max-measure form with container-responsive rows.

states.name: default
states.description: Complete target-defined canonical field composition in a native Form.

states.name: responsiveRow
states.description: Optional canonical row changes from two tracks to one according to the form container without reordering DOM or focus.

states.name: actionsPresent
states.description: Optional canonical Form actions contain explicit submit and optional non-reset cancellation.

behavior.name: canonicalForm
behavior.description: Form owns the native submission boundary, section, row, action, and optional error-summary composition while U7 adds only localized address-field and compact container layout specialization.

behavior.name: completeFieldComposition
behavior.description: The required slot composes the complete canonical Input and Select controls selected by the target address model; the docs fixture is not a universal schema.

behavior.name: canonicalComposition
behavior.description: Form retains native submission and action layout; Input and Select retain label, name, value, autocomplete, requiredness, validation, focus, and controlled or uncontrolled ownership; Button retains activation, disabled, and busy ownership.

behavior.name: explicitSubmission
behavior.description: Create or update is triggered only by explicit native form submission; field change, blur, and option selection do not auto-submit.

behavior.name: nativeConstraintValidation
behavior.description: Preserve native required validation. Targets adding custom or server validation identify errors in canonical field messages and compose a useful linked Form error summary when needed.

behavior.name: cancelComposition
attributes: type=button on cancellation command or native link navigation
behavior.description: Optional Cancel requests target navigation or closure. It never uses type=reset and never implies that draft field values were restored or discarded.

behavior.name: externalLifecycle
behavior.description: Authentication, localized address schema, create or edit mode, mutation, pending, success, failure, cancellation, routing, focus recovery, feedback, analytics, and telemetry remain target-owned outside U7.

behavior.name: responsiveContainer
behavior.description: Canonical Form and U7 row/action rules respond to the same component container while maximum measure and thresholds remain private composition.

properties.name: fields
properties.description: Complete target-owned localized canonical address controls with visible labels, stable names, values, autocomplete purpose, requiredness, validation semantics, and optional canonical Form error summary when needed.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: Target-selected canonical explicit submit and optional navigation/close cancellation actions; Cancel never implies reset and lifecycle remains external.

accessibility: Protect address editing and mutation through target authentication, authorization, and privacy controls before rendering U7.

Use canonical Form with native form, section, row, action, and optional error-summary semantics plus canonical Input, Select, and Button controls without adding parent widget roles or keyboard handling.
Associate every control with a visible label, unique id, stable successful-control name, and correct autocomplete purpose for the actual value.
Preserve native required constraint validation and explicit submit; never auto-submit on change, blur, or country selection.
Custom and server errors must identify the affected field in canonical text feedback, use canonical field association, and move focus to the first invalid control or useful linked Form error summary.
Keep Submit explicit. Optional Cancel is target navigation or close composition with Button type=button or Link semantics; it must not reset draft values implicitly.
Responsive rows must preserve DOM, reading, serialization, and focus order when the component container narrows.
Mutation pending, success, failure, authentication expiry, cancellation, focus recovery, and announcements remain target composition outside U7.
U7 adds no motion, focus ring, color, icon, or forced-colors behavior; canonical dependencies retain those responsibilities.

web.notes: Implemented as canonical Form plus the localized U7 layout specialization in components/css/account.css, with no U7 runtime.

shopify.notes: Shopify v1 uses hosted current-account Profile/Addresses as an intentional native handoff with no U7 parity claim. Target-controlled headless storefronts may project canonical U7 against authenticated Customer Account address mutations and field-addressable user errors. Classic Liquid is separately versioned compatibility; copied CSS is not readiness.
